note: Readiness / intake checks as configuration. Each rule is advisory and Unverified until a reviewer records the exact APH clause in docs/SOURCES.md; an Unverified rule never blocks, returns or rejects an application (PRD §0). Dates are never stored here — cut-off dates live in calendars.json so there is one source of truth per year.

cut_off.rule: An application submitted after the Public Notice cut-off is queued for the next Academic Year.
cut_off.reject_note: The plan implements the tag half of FR-02 only — 'never reject' — because PRD §0 forbids an Unverified rule from blocking or rejecting. FR-02's literal wording also says 'reject from processing'; that half is deliberately NOT implemented and would need a human approval gate plus a verified cut-off date before it could ever be switched on.
cut_off.date_source_note: The cut-off date is looked up for the submission's calendar year. If no date is recorded for that year the check answers needs_review — never 'no cut-off applies' — because calendars.json ships with no year loaded (IMPL-0016).
